svg.text: d2s_sp2k: 2 kOhm secondary protection stage in front of CMA / CMB (pad level, 2 instances)
IHP's sg13cmos5l_SecondaryProtection with a longer resistor, as drawn in d2s_sp2k_f2 (C2, F2 stage B, 2026-11-03):
rppd 1u x 7.435u (1991.6 Ohm) from the pad to core; dantenna 0.64u x 3.1u core to iovss, dpantenna 0.64u x 4.98u core to iovdd.
